answer: Epoch 135: split the attestation graph into islands and pay only bridge flow. Weight comes from attestations that cross island lines, and every bridge must age like cedar, standing for several closes before it carries a vote. A clone farm is one island: dense internal vines carry zero weight, so faking influence means renting unaffiliated neighbors abroad and watering each vine for epochs before it fruits. Rent scales with fleet size; an honest agent crossing neighborhoods earns full weight for free.
